observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teachers work as a pair, with one demonstrating and explaining while the other models the partner's role. They maintain a friendly, encouraging tone throughout the lesson.

lesson_structure.note: The teachers introduce themselves and the topic.
The teachers explain the neutral position and weight transfer.
The teachers break down the side step.
The teachers break down the forward and back steps.
The teachers combine the side, forward, and back steps.
The teachers introduce the box step (baldosas).
The teachers explain how to listen to the music and practice the box step with music.
The teachers demonstrate the box step with a partner.

metaphors: keep the heart of the tango

steps_taught.name: side step
steps_taught.description: A lateral step followed by closing the feet.

steps_taught.name: forward step
steps_taught.description: A step forward followed by closing the feet.

steps_taught.name: back step
steps_taught.description: A step backward followed by closing the feet.

steps_taught.name: box step (baldosas)
steps_taught.description: A combination of side, forward, and back steps.

what_works: The teachers break down the steps into small, manageable parts.
The use of a partner helps to visualize the steps.
what_hinders: The video is a bit repetitive.

quotes.text: This is the position we call neutral position.
Which is we means collect in tango.
In Spanish, we call it baldosa.
Who keep the heart of the tango, the heartbeat of the tango.

evidence_segments.observation: The teachers stand side-by-side, facing the camera, introducing the lesson.
The teachers demonstrate the neutral position with feet together and toes slightly turned out.
The teachers demonstrate the side step by sliding one foot to the side and then closing it.
The teachers demonstrate the forward step by stepping forward and then closing the feet.
The teachers demonstrate the box step by combining the side, forward, and back steps.

extraction.distinctive_method: The teachers use Spanish terminology for the steps, which adds authenticity to the lesson.
